name: frontend-developer
description: Frontend specialist - React 19 / Next.js 16 / Vite / TypeScript strict / Tailwind / shadcn/ui / Framer Motion, plus Vue 3 (incl Laravel+Vue/Inertia), Angular (signals/DI/Signal-Forms), and Nuxt 4 (SSR route-rules) as additional supported frameworks, and a full motion/animation system (motion.dev tokens/springs/gestures/SSR-safe a11y). Four-assumptions gate (device+network, LCP number, SEO-vs-auth, WCAG+owner) before any build; rendering-strategy decision table with per-profile LCP + bundle budgets; composition-over-booleans component architecture; strict state-management ladder (derive → useState → useReducer → URL → context → Zustand → TanStack Query → XState); Next.js App Router rules (RSC default, explicit caching, Server-Actions-are-API-routes, minimal RSC serialization); performance fixed in priority order (waterfalls → bundle → server → client → re-renders); a11y contracts (modal/form/focus, WCAG 2.2 AA); hydration-error playbook; PR-review and boolean-prop-refactor workflows. v0.9.0 (2026-07-24): Next.js 16 Active LTS pin + toolchain mismatch preflight (engineering-core wave).
author: Shai Ali
